entries.zh: 阎君，即阎罗王，地狱之主。
entries.en: king of the devils; Yama, lord of hell.
Yama, king of the devils; lord of hell.

entries.zh: 皇天，至大之天，喻天上之君王、天帝。
entries.en: August Heaven, the great king of heaven.
queen; empress.
mother of the realm; queen/empress.
queen; royal lady; female governor.
entries.notes: M 栏混入西语 gobernadora，兼作释义；『王娘』指王后。

entries.en: queen; empress.
kingdom; realm; province.
entries.notes: L 缩写『pru.』推为 provincia（省/邦），故并列二义。

entries.en: kingdom; state; realm.
province; prefecture; administrative division.
endangered realm; kingdom without peace.

entries.zh: 竺，天竺之略称，指印度；亦为姓氏。
entries.en: Zhu; short for Tianzhu (India); also a surname.
entries.notes: L『reyno de muchos』语义不明，与 H『竺』不相合，疑原稿有误。

entries.en: queen bee; ruler of the hive.
entries.notes: L 字面为『蜂之国』，H『蜂王』指蜂后。

entries.en: Tianzhu, the old Chinese name for India; literally 'Kingdom of Heaven'.
entries.notes: L『reyno del ciels』就『天』字直解，H『天竺國』实指印度。

entries.en: kingdom of the North; the Northern Ocean realm.
kingdom; realm; state.
peaceful realm; kingdom at peace.
entries.notes: L 残作『quie…o』，据 H 平善、M pēng sièn 推为 reyno quieto。

entries.en: endangered realm; kingdom without peace.

entries.zh: 西洋国，西方海域之国；明代指西洋、欧洲一带。
entries.en: the Western Ocean realm; the West.
the Eastern Ocean realm; the East.

entries.zh: 一统，天下统一，四海一统。
entries.en: unified realm; all under one crown.
entries.notes: L 末有残缺；H『一統』与冠冕在首之喻相合，释为统一之国。

entries.zh: 南洋国，南洋海域之国（指令东南亚一带）。
entries.en: the Southern Seas realm; the kingdom toward the west (Nanyang).
entries.notes: L 作『向西之国』，自马尼拉视南洋正在西面，与 H 合。
